rationale: The agent processed an exchange without authenticating the user, did not retrieve or confirm the relevant order or item details, and failed to obtain explicit user confirmation before performing order-changing actions, which the policy requires. It asserted specific replacement models (coffee machine at 9 bar; laptop model) and a refund to a gift card without showing tool-based verification (e.g., checking availability of 8 bar first, then 9, then 7; matching capacity/type; confirming the cheapest i7 option; verifying prices). The agent also unilaterally chose payment/refund handling without confirming with the user. These constitute acting without required confirmation and potentially fabricating unsupported details, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
